verdict.rationale: Databricks documents its own versioning for assets that can drive automations: notebooks have automatic versioning (docs-12/37), SQL queries have version history (docs-5), and agents deployed via Databricks Apps support git-based versioning (docs-92). It also documents Git-like versioning, commit messages and rollback for prompts in the MLflow Prompt Registry (docs-91), but nothing shows versioning, review or rollback for jobs, pipelines or workflows as automation objects. missing for 10: documented version history and rollback for jobs/Lakeflow pipelines, a review/approval workflow for automation changes, explicit rollback for notebooks and agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
